title: Workday Integration Senior
description:
Position Overview
We are seeking a Workday Integration Consultant with deep expertise in HR technology and integration solutions. This role will focus on delivering integration fixes and enhancements. The ideal candidate brings both Integrations with connectors and studio integration skills to help the clients.
Key Responsibilities
Integration Strategy & Delivery
  • Lead and execute Workday integration projects across various integration types (EIB, Core Connectors, Studio, Cloud Connect, Custom APIs)
  • Design, build, test, and deploy integrations between Workday and third-party systems (payroll, benefits, time tracking, talent management platforms)
  • Develop integration roadmap and recommendations aligned with client business objectives
  • Lead requirements-gathering sessions and communicate effectively with clients and other key stakeholders.
Technical Excellence
  • Troubleshoot and resolve complex integration issues, including error handling and monitoring
  • Maintain integration documentation including technical specifications, data dictionaries, and runbooks
  • Establish integration best practices and governance frameworks
  • Monitor integration performance and implement improvements for reliability and efficiency
Client Engagement
  • Serve as a trusted advisor to clients on integration strategy and HR technology optimization
  • Present findings and recommendations to client stakeholders including technical and business audiences
  • Manage stakeholder expectations and communicate project status effectively


Required Qualifications
Certifications & Experience
  • Workday Integration Certification(s) - Core, Studio, or Cloud Connect
  • 6-9 years of hands-on Workday integration experience
  • Proven track record of working on Workday integration projects focusing customer interaction
  • Excellent communication skills
Technical Skills
  • Strong understanding of Workday architecture, security model, and data structures
  • Proficiency with Workday integration tools: EIB, Studio, Cloud Connect, Core Connectors, Document Transformation, Report Writer
  • Working knowledge of integration technologies: REST/SOAP APIs, XML, XSLT, JSON, web services
Domain Expertise
  • Deep knowledge of HR business processes across HCM, Payroll
  • Understanding of downstream/upstream system integrations (ADP, Fidelity, SAP, Oracle, etc.)
Preferred Qualifications
  • Prior consulting experience with Big 4 or Tier 1 consulting firms
  • Familiarity with Agile/Scrum project management approaches
  • Background in change management and training delivery
Key Competencies
Technical Acumen
  • Analytical thinking and problem-solving abilities
  • Attention to detail in complex data mapping scenarios
  • Ability to quickly learn new technologies and adapt to changing requirements

Business Acumen
  • Understanding of HR operations and business drivers
  • Ability to translate business requirements into technical solutions
  • Strategic thinking around system optimization
Communication & Collaboration
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical audiences
  • Strong facilitation and presentation skills
  • Collaborative mindset with ability to work across global, cross-functional teams
Professional Skills
  • Self-starter with ability to work independently
  • Strong organizational and time management capabilities
  • Comfort with ambiguity and fast-paced client environments

title: Workday Time Tracking
description:
Position Overview
We are seeking an experienced Workday Time Tracking Consultant to join our dynamic team. The ideal candidate will have 3-8 years of hands-on experience implementing, configuring, and supporting Workday Time Tracking solutions for enterprise clients. This role requires deep functional and technical expertise in Workday's time and absence management capabilities, along with strong client relationship and problem-solving skills.
Key Responsibilities
Implementation & Configuration
  • Lead or participate in end-to-end Workday Time Tracking implementations, including requirements gathering, design, configuration, testing, and deployment
  • Configure time tracking setup including time entry methods, time off plans, time codes, time calculation rules, and time blocks
  • Design and implement complex time tracking business processes, including approvals, validations, and integrations
  • Configure scheduled processes for time calculations, accruals, and carryover functionality
  • Build and maintain time tracking reports and dashboards to support operational and compliance needs
Client Engagement
  • Serve as a subject matter expert for Workday Time Tracking, advising clients on best practices and industry standards
  • Facilitate requirements workshops and design sessions with stakeholders across HR, Finance, Payroll, and IT
  • Translate business requirements into technical solutions that leverage Workday's native capabilities
  • Provide knowledge transfer and training to client teams and end users
  • Manage client expectations and communicate project status, risks, and issues effectively
Integration & Data Management
  • Design and support integrations between Workday Time Tracking and external systems (payroll, ERP, third-party time clocks)
  • Collaborate with integration teams on EIB loads, Core Connectors, and Web Services
  • Ensure data integrity and accuracy in time tracking records through validation rules and audits
  • Support bi-annual Workday updates by testing time tracking functionality and implementing new features
Support & Optimization
  • Provide post-production support for time tracking issues, troubleshooting configuration problems and user errors
  • Analyze time tracking processes and recommend optimizations to improve efficiency and user experience
  • Maintain documentation including functional specifications, configuration guides, and training materials
  • Stay current on Workday product roadmap and new time tracking features through community engagement and training
Required Qualifications
Experience
  • 3-8 years of hands-on experience with Workday Time Tracking configuration and implementation
  • Proven track record of delivering at least 2-3 full-cycle Workday Time Tracking implementations
  • Experience configuring time entry methods, time codes, schedules, and time calculation rules
  • Strong understanding of time tracking business processes across multiple industries and regulatory environments
Technical Skills
  • Deep knowledge of Workday Time Tracking module including configuration, reporting, and business process framework
  • Proficiency with Workday reporting tools (Report Writer, Composite Reports, Advanced Reports)
  • Understanding of Workday integration tools (EIB, Core Connectors, Studio)
  • Familiarity with Workday security model and role-based permissions
Functional Knowledge
  • Strong understanding of HR, payroll, and time & attendance business processes
  • Knowledge of labor law compliance requirements (FLSA, state-specific regulations)
  • Understanding of absence management and how it integrates with time tracking
  • Experience with various time capture methods (manual entry, mobile, biometric, badges)
Professional Skills
  • Excellent communication skills with ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical audiences
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a collaborative team
  • Client-facing experience with professional presence and business acumen
  • Strong organizational skills with ability to manage multiple priorities
Preferred Qualifications
  • Workday Time Tracking Pro Certification
  • Additional Workday module experience (HCM, Absence Management, Payroll)
  • Experience with Workday Projects or Professional Services Automation (PSA)
  • Knowledge of workforce management tools and integration patterns
  • Experience in consulting or professional services environment
  • Bachelor's degree in HR, Business, IT, or related field
What Success Looks Like
In this role, you'll be successful when you:
  • Deliver high-quality Workday Time Tracking solutions that meet client requirements and timelines
  • Build trusted advisor relationships with clients through expertise and responsiveness
  • Proactively identify risks and propose mitigation strategies
  • Contribute to the team's knowledge base and help develop junior consultants
  • Maintain utilization targets while delivering exceptional client service

title: Senior PMO Japanese Bilingual Position
description:
Role: PMO - Japanese Bilingual
Level: Consultant
Role Summary:
Artificial Intelligence & Engineering
Join our AI & Engineering team in transforming technology platforms, driving innovation, and helping make a significant impact on our clients' achievements. You'll work alongside talented professionals reimagining and re-engineering operations and processes that are critical to business. Your contributions help Client client service teams improve financial performance, accelerate new digital ventures, and fuel growth through innovation.

Position Summary
Level: Senior Consultant or equivalent
At Client Consulting, you will be responsible for supporting the delivery of strategic project and portfolio outcomes within due timelines, ensuring initiatives are aligned with enterprise objectives and deliver measurable business value. You will contribute to a culture of agility and data-driven decision-making, leveraging modern analytics, hybrid methodologies, and AI-augmented tooling to support portfolio health, transparency, and execution. Need-basis you will be mentoring junior team members and liaising with onsite/offshore teams to ensure consistent reporting standards, governance, and stakeholder alignment.

Work you'll do:
You will support strategic alignment and value delivery across the project portfolio, helping ensure initiatives advance the organization's strategic goals and OKRs. Contribute to the evolution of PMO operations toward a Value Management Office (VMO) model — shifting focus from simple project completion to continuous value delivery — and support the adoption of hybrid project methodologies (Agile, Scrum, Waterfall) that meet business needs. Transform project data into actionable insights for leadership using data visualization tools such as Power BI and Tableau; develop and maintain dashboards that communicate portfolio health, delivery confidence, risk exposure, and financial outcomes. Track and link project performance to tangible business outcomes, benefits realization, and return on investment, and leverage AI-powered tools to augment reporting and identify risks earlier. Proactively support portfolio prioritization, resource optimization, predictive risk management, and cross-project dependency management. Partner with diverse teams and stakeholders to drive alignment, support sponsor engagement, and facilitate organizational change management activities for successful transformation outcomes.

The team:
Engineering as a Service provides complete design, implementation, and technology operations, leveraging our core engineering expertise. We transform engineering teams, modernize technology, and deliver complex programs with a product engineering approach. Our flexible delivery models—traditional teams, pools, or pods—are tailored to each client's needs, offering engineering-led advisory, implementation, and operational capabilities to accelerate innovation.




Qualifications
Must Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications:
  • 6+ years of hands-on experience in a PMO, project/program management, or consulting role within a dynamic IT or business transformation environment.
  • Demonstrated experience working across a mix of project methodologies, including Agile, Scrum, Waterfall, and hybrid delivery models.
  • Strong data fluency, with proficiency in data analysis and visualization tools (Power BI, Tableau, Excel) to create compelling, insight-driven reports for leadership.
  • Expertise in modern project management tools (Jira, Azure DevOps), with proven ability to build dashboards that increase transparency and drive decisions.
  • Experience enabling teams through flow metrics, Objective Key Results (OKRs), and value-based KPIs, linking project performance to tangible business outcomes, benefits realization, and ROI.
  • Strong financial acumen with a solid understanding of budget management, forecasting, and resource capacity planning to inform investment and prioritization decisions.
  • Technical literacy across modern technology landscapes, including CI/CD processes, release management strategies (A/B testing, Canary, Blue Green, Rolling Deployments), and version control systems.
  • Experience supporting risk management activities — identifying budget, timeline, and delivery risks early, and contributing to mitigation strategies.
  • Excellent communication and documentation skills, with ability to articulate complex information clearly, tell a compelling story with data, and produce structured reports for stakeholder review.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to navigate ambiguity and structure approaches to complex delivery challenges.
  • Demonstrated ability to act as a trusted advisor, build relationships and effectively across project teams, business stakeholders, and senior management.
  • Exemplary judgment and integrity in handling sensitive and confidential information.
  • Strong team player, able to work closely with project managers, delivery leads, business analysts, developers, and cross-functional teams to deliver integrated, high-quality outcomes.
  • Japanese Language Proficiency Test (JLPT) cleared at level N2 or higher

Language Proficiency
  • English – A high degree of fluency is essential for all verbal and written communication
  • Japanese – Minimum requirement of Japanese language proficiency at the JLPT (Japanese Language Proficiency Test) N2 level or higher
Good to Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications:
  • Agile certifications such as CSM, PSM, or SAFe Agilist.
  • Strategic or value-focused certifications such as PMI-PMOCP, MoV, or VMO-CP.
  • Good grasp of AI concepts and recent trends as they apply to PMO operations — including AI-augmented reporting, predictive risk management, and intelligent portfolio analytics — with the ability to suggest practical implementation ideas within a project context.
  • Experience contributing to PMO transformation initiatives, including the shift from traditional PMO to VMO operating models.
  • Familiarity with organizational change management frameworks (e.g., Prosci ADKAR, Kotter) and supporting change activities within transformation programs.

Education:
BE/B.Tech/M.C.A./M.Sc (CS) degree or equivalent from accredited university. Bachelor's degree in a relevant business or management discipline with equivalent PMO experience also considered.

Location:
Gurgaon/Pune/Bengaluru/Hyderabad/Chennai/Kolkata
